description: The Industrial Plant Data Viewer lets the public see and compare plant-level data on emissions, fuel and water use, production, efficiency and permit conditions for large combustion plants in the European Union, such as power stations, combined heat and power plants feeding the grid and district heating plants. It builds on reporting under the Industrial Emissions Directive and the European Pollutant Release and Transfer Register, which together cover over 50,000 installations, and fills gaps through the European Environmental Bureau's own research, since many member states do not publish compliance reports and monitoring results. It was created by the EEB in 2020 and comes with a methodology note and a briefing on member states' practice. Coverage is the EU. The viewer is free online; no licence is stated, and the EEB disclaims responsibility for errors in the source data from industry and authorities. Caveats: the first version covers large combustion plants only, and the EEB is an environmental campaign organisation that uses the viewer to test compliance with emission limits. For simulation it provides plant-level operating and emission data for industrial and power plants, useful for environmental impact, fuel supply and capacity planning models of European industry. It is related to the eSPIRS Seveso plants record in this catalogue, which lists hazardous industrial sites in the EU.
